changed.title: Mixed row and column OR pools price paired-decoder errors by ternary colorings with separate pin budgets
changed.statement:
∀ (n q : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin n → Bool) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
  let I := Fin n
  let P := Fin q
  let pools := fun (R C : P → Finset I) (x y : I) (j : P) => decide (x ∈ R j ∨ π y ∈ C j)
  let loss := fun (R C : P → Finset I) (out : Finset I → (P → Bool) → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z =>
      out {z.1,z.2} (pools R C z.1 z.2) ≠ G z.1 (π z.2))).card
  ∀ (r c e : ℕ),
    (∃ (R C : P → Finset I) (out : Finset I → (P → Bool) → Bool),
      (∑ j, (R j).card) ≤ r ∧ (∑ j, (C j).card) ≤ c ∧ loss R C out ≤ e) ↔
    ∃ f : I → P → Fin 3,
      (∑ j : P, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun v => f v j = 1)).card) ≤ r ∧
      (∑ j : P, ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun w => f w j = 2)).card) ≤ c ∧
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (I × I)).filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2 ∧
        f z.1 = f z.2 ∧ G z.1 (π z.2) ≠ G z.2 (π z.1))).card ≤ e
changed.unlocks: characterizes fixed-matching decoder error by ternary labels with separate row and column pin budgets
changed.context: A pool assigns each matched label to neither bank, row only, column only, or both. The initial three types distinguish every unequal pair under reversal. Both distinguishes none, so replacing it by neither preserves every distinction and saves its two pins. Realize the three digits by physical memberships. The OR bank identifies the unordered pair. Equal addresses leave its two orientations merged, costing one cell exactly when the target bits differ. Unequal addresses allow both orientations to be read.
